segments.text: So, yatham asaditha prakarsha yogi, when a yogi has attained the intensity of this
supreme state of God consciousness, asaditha prakarsha, the supreme intensity of God consciousness.
He becomes, she will tullo jaiti, he becomes just like Shiva.
He does not become one with Shiva, huh?
He becomes just like Shiva, not Shiva.
Turi parashilana prakarsha, by the intensity of meditating on Turi, Turi chamatkara,
the one who has praft, Turiyatitapada, who has obtained and achieved the state of Turiyatitapada.
Paripurna satcha satchanda chidanandagani nishveena, Lord Shiva who is all around full with pure
and independent consciousness and independent bliss.
He becomes like him, Bhagavata tullyo, he becomes like him, why he has explained,
he becomes like him, why not him, why does not he become one with Shiva, Shiva?
He does not become one with Shiva, he becomes like him, because deha kalaya avikaranath,
he has obtained this body, this physical frame.
As long as his physical frame is existing, he is just like Shiva, he is not one with Shiva,
because physical frame will divert him towards inferior states,
constant scuffing, headaches, pain, stomach pain, ulcer, fever,
all these things do not happen to Shiva.
So, as long as his body is there, deha kalaya is there,
this deha kalaya is there, so he becomes like just like Shiva, he does not become one with Shiva.
That vikaranana, when he throws away this physical frame of five elements,
satcha chivyeva, so then he becomes one with Shiva in the end, when he throws this physical frame.
Tathachishi Kalika Krami, in Kalika Kram, Shastra it is said,
tasmat nityam asandigdam buddva yogam gurur mukhat, ayukalpe na bhaave na bhaave na tanmayata,
yavata samatam yati Bhagavan Bhairava Bravita, tasmat, so asandigdam without any doubt,
this yoga, this practical yoga of entering in God consciousness everywhere,
you should one should learn from the mouth of his master, one should learn from the mouth of his master,
not without abhikalpe na bhaave na, just taking each and every word of his master as granted.
Don't put any doubt while you hear those words from his mouth.
If you put any doubt in the least also,
must you are away from that God consciousness.
Without any doubt it should listen to him, and bhaave na tanmayata, then you should
try to experience that state,
becoming one with that, till you become one with that God consciousness.
This is said by Lord Shiva himself, so it is absolute fact, truth.
Ava Mape, although this is like that,
yenidam tati bhagata, by which action this body has been brought forth
into being, that karma will get its end by enjoying it or not by casting it aside.
That karma, that prayer of the karma cannot, you cannot overcome that prayer of the karma unless you
enjoy it. So, prayer of the karma is unavoidable for each and every being. Maybe he may be just like Shiva,
he may be just ordinary person, prayer of the karma, he has to overcome. He can't cast it aside,
he can't abandon it. So, open at the Boga ativa-hanamata prayujana, but his way of his remaining life
is just go on with this physical frame as it is. Open at the Boga ativa-hanam prayujana, whatever he gets
to eat, he must eat it, whatever he gets good or bad, he must welcome it in his remaining
period of life, for this satchayogi. So, for satchayogi, dehasati, this establishment in that physical
body is not atikramaniya, he is not worth casting aside, he is not worth living behind.
This dehasati, you have to maintain until death comes. This explains in this next sutra.
